senses.gloss: ऋ ind. An interjection of- (1) calling; (2) ridicule; (3) censure.
ऋ (I) vt. 1P (pp. ऋत, caus. अर्पय्; desid. अरिरिष्) (In conjugational tenses the base of this root is ऋच्छ्) To go, e.g. नरः पतनमृच्छति.With सम्-, (A) to join.
ऋ (II) vt. 3P (pp. ऋत) (mostly used in the Vedas) 1. To go; 2. to meet; 3. to gain, to acquire.
ऋ (III) vt. 5P (pp. ऋण) 1. To hurt; 2. to attack.
ॠ ind. An interjection of- (1) terror; (2) reproach; (3) compassion; (4) remembrance &c.
ॠ vt. 9P (pp. ईर्ण) To go, to move.
